instruction: Generate compatibility.json from supplied old_api.json and new_api.json without modifying source, fixtures, or configuration. Each file maps exported names to exact signature strings. Report sorted name lists under exactly removed (old only), changed (in both but signature differs), and added (new only). Output is a JSON object with those three arrays. Only compatibility.json may be created or changed. Signature comparison is exact string equality; implementation internals and version labels are irrelevant. The supplied files are the entire input.
